children: South Korea's exports jumped 83.5% yoy to USD 120.9 billion in September 2026, surpassing estimates of 61.7% and accelerating from an upwardly revised 68.7% jump in August, marking the fastest increase since February 1974.
Exports rose for the 16th consecutive month, reaching a record monthly high after exceeding USD 100 billion for the first time in June.
The increase was driven by strong demand for memory chips, with semiconductor exports rising for the 16th consecutive month and surpassing USD 60 billion for the first time.

title: South Korea Exports Hit Fresh Record High
